decisions.reason: The existing message-887 MODIFY already captures the actionable VBACKUP changes: placement beside PWROK and exposure without a populated backup component. The additional examples explain its existing RTC-retention purpose without requiring another state change.
The R16/R17/R18 pull-up decision concerns separate GPIO button inputs, not the panel-mounted AXP2101 PWRON button interface.
Mentioning main-battery removal while explaining VBACKUP does not change the battery connector type, pin functions, access, or unresolved pin order.
The VRTC and VBACKUP decisions do not modify battery overcharge, overdischarge, thermal sensing, or protection requirements.
Leaving VRTC unconnected and exposing VBACKUP do not alter DCDC1 voltage, current rating, or rail-compensation behavior.
The source decision does not change which rails are monitored or the selected current-monitoring implementation.
The pin-specific VRTC and VBACKUP handling leaves the AXP2101 selection, charging behavior, system rails, and normal-operation power path unchanged.
The source does not address charge-status indication, J_LED_CHG, R6, D1, or their population states.
PWROK is referenced only as the location beside which the VBACKUP pad should be placed; its own breakout and debugging purpose remain unchanged.
The absence of an external RTC and the VRTC/VBACKUP pin decisions do not affect standalone USB activation, regulation, loads, or source selection.
The source makes no change to the AXP2101 underside thermal-pad or cooling implementation.
AXP2101 internal-RTC backup retention is distinct from the ESP32 sleep policy and its timer and touch wake sources, none of which are changed.
